raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below.
- [ ] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)).

## Affected area

CI or test infrastructure.

## Summary

Add 60 deterministic convolution cases covering forward, data-gradient, and weight-gradient operations, including ReLU and residual-add fusions. Preserve the existing 16 fixed cases and the convolution fuzzer's default behavior.

- Cover FP16, BF16, and FP32 inputs with FP32 computation across nine convolution configurations, including rectangular inputs, singleton spatial axes, and different filter sizes.
- Represent the convolution intermediate's dtype explicitly so the reference rounds at the same graph edge.
- Exercise both virtual and materialized weight-gradient intermediates, checking every exposed output independently.
- Add 21 small reference checks covering intermediate rounding, residual addition, activation, and default behavior.
- Mark the new GPU matrix L1, with a separate test entrypoint for focused selection. This change does not modify CI configuration; existing jobs selecting L1 will include these cases.

- `test/python/conv/graph/test_conv_fixed.py` defines the fixed parameter matrix, executes the cases, and checks final and materialized intermediate outputs.
- `test/python/conv/graph/test_conv_fuzzer.py` provides the shared graph and reference helpers. Optional intermediate settings preserve existing defaults; backward ReLU is available for the new fixed cases.

## Why

Add reproducible coverage for convolution fusion and intermediate rounding combinations that should run consistently rather than depend on random selection. Reuse the existing graph and reference helpers so fixed cases and the fuzzer share the same execution path, while checking materialized convolution results independently of the final fused output.

## Related issues

None.

## API and compatibility impact

No public API, binding, or production-library changes. Existing fixed-case parameters and fuzzer defaults are preserved. The new GPU cases use L1; CI configuration is unchanged.

Capability and planning-time support rejections remain skips. Execution failures, non-finite outputs, and numerical mismatches remain failures. This does not expand the library's supported GPU or software configurations.

## Testing

Validated with cuDNN 9.x, serially with test-process isolation disabled:

| GPU | Complete fixed suite | Fixed-suite runtime | Focused fuzzer regression |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| L40S | 97 passed, 0 skipped | 22.37s | 8 passed, 0 skipped |
| H100 | 97 passed, 0 skipped | 17.00s | 8 passed, 0 skipped |
| B100 | 97 passed, 0 skipped | 16.86s | 8 passed, 0 skipped |

The fixed suite includes 76 GPU cases and 21 reference checks. The GPU cases are now four L0 and 72 L1; the 21 reference checks are L0. The GPU results above were recorded before the marker-only L2-to-L1 change; testcase parameters and execution are unchanged. The focused fuzzer run selects eight existing cases, with 2089 deselected. Each run emitted one PyTorch cuBLAS primary-context initialization warning.

After the marker change, focused collection confirmed 25 L0 tests, 72 L1 tests, and 97 combined. Focused pre-commit hooks and `git diff --check` passed. The expansion alone remains selectable with `-k test_conv_fixed_expansion_L1`.

From `test/python`:

```bash
CUDNN_TEST_NO_ISOLATION=1 python -m pytest conv/graph/test_conv_fixed.py \
  -o "addopts=" -m "L0 or L1" --tb=short --no-header \
  -p no:cacheprovider --junit-xml=result-junit.xml
```

Focused fuzzer regression, also from `test/python`:

```bash
CUDNN_TEST_NO_ISOLATION=1 python -m pytest -n 0 conv/graph/test_conv_fuzzer.py \
  -o "addopts=" -m L0 \
  -k 'test_conv_random_L0 and (t1_ or t2_ or t3_ or t4_ or t5_ or t6_ or t7_ or t8_)' \
  --tb=short --no-header -p no:cacheprovider --junit-xml=fuzzer-junit.xml
```

This is focused validation, not a full-fuzzer run or a kernel-performance benchmark. Times are pytest-reported suite durations, including setup and reference checks.

Focused formatting and license checks passed. From the repository root:

```bash
pre-commit run --files test/python/conv/graph/test_conv_fixed.py \
  test/python/conv/graph/test_conv_fuzzer.py
git diff --check
```

  * Added checks for intermediate rounding, residual and activation behavior, and numerical agreement between computed and expected results.
  * Added coverage for device capability requirements and materialized intermediate results.
